coordinateSystem: Original DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame, +Z spin pole and +X reference meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 458, version 2012-09-20: ecliptic J2000 pole (219, -70) degrees; period 5.710153 hours; equatorial conversion with obliquity 23.439291111 degrees.
